title: CURRENCY ( -0.03125 ) is -0.0313: a negative exact half rounds away from zero

source.quote: Rounding up occurs if the 5th significant decimal is equal or larger than 5
source.supports: CURRENCY rounds on the fifth decimal; the page gives 3.6666666666666 as 3.6667 and 3.0123456789 as 3.0123

source.quote: truncating the values past the four digits to the right of decimal separator
source.supports: the other reading: the fixed decimal type truncates past four decimals

derivation: -0.03125 is -1/32, exact in binary floating point: a true tie between -0.0312 and -0.0313. Reading the CURRENCY page's rule (the fourth decimal is rounded when the fifth is 5 or larger) on the magnitude gives -0.0313.
alternative: Round half to even, truncation, or rounding up toward positive infinity all give -0.0312.
